scope: Special Modifications (1_65) current normal text and Premiere Millennium Falcon (1_143), plus existing Han (1_11)/Lando (5_5) matching pilot branches; all admission gates remain closed.
executionNote: The Special Modifications class succeeded with 11 observations; the batched process failed in a separate hit-departure test. The copied per-class Surefire summary certifies only Special Modifications. Earlier incorrect pilot fixture was corrected to BoardAsPilot before this receipt.

officialRules.rule: Current Special Modifications errata restricts deployment to your starship; pay 1 Force and add 2 to armor/maneuver, plus 2 power/forfeit on Falcon with Han/Lando/Chewie piloting.
Effects attached to stolen starships remain attached but are not themselves stolen.
Unpiloted attributes and acting pilot restrictions apply to landed and unpiloted craft; external modifiers do not override unmodifiable zero.

method: Initial ship, pilot-slot placement, Force and starting locations are controlled fixtures. Effect deployment executes real player actions and pays 1 Force. Named cancellations use trusted text-cancellation effects, not a claim about a particular cancellation card.

Ten legal own-host rows match exactly between native command sequences and executed GEMP for costs, power, armor, maneuver, forfeit, immunity and Effect owner. Additional native-only tests cover six-Force Falcon/Han simultaneous deployment followed by the Effect, refresh, uniqueness, invalid targets/payment, cancellation, target departure/reentry, pending owner change, ion resets, capacity, battle if-unable destiny and excluded pilots.

Current stat bonuses require a named acting pilot; suppressing that pilot text does not erase persona qualifications. Suppressing Effect text removes its contributions; suppressing Falcon text removes ship immunity but preserves external Effect/pilot bonuses.

Native actual Effect deployment followed by a controlled capture foundation and real theft continuation verifies unchanged Effect owner, retained attachment/armor and separate owner Lost piles. This is not a newly executed GEMP capture oracle; it is linked to existing theft-response evidence.

knownDiscrepancies.reference: Pinned Card1_065 accepts old any-starship deployment; retained observation shows a Light Effect deployed for 1 Force on a Dark Star Destroyer.
knownDiscrepancies.native: Current official page 128 your-starship errata rejects that action. This row explicitly checks refusal rather than claiming result parity; existing attached Effects continue working after theft.

knownDiscrepancies.reference: Existing theft-response-results.json transfers Effect ownership with the ship, contrary to official page 173.
knownDiscrepancies.native: Retains the original Effect owner while the ship changes owner. The existing immutable theft oracle and discrepancy receipt are preserved.

limitations: No doubling or other cards that modify Special Modifications text are implemented or certified; the normal current card text is the bounded scope.
Han and Lando are real supported matching-pilot fixtures. Chewie persona matching is generic but no unimplemented Chewie card version is admitted or certified.
Falcon ship-docking-capability integration and browser checks are verified separately by parent-owned tests. No full match or full catalog claim.
Lando other text, broader ship stat definitions, unrelated card providers and other Falcon versions remain outside this component oracle.
